title: Canonical Format: HTML5 Banner
description: Interactive HTML5 banner delivered as a zip archive. Slot: `html5_bundle` (zip asset). Tracking model: MRAID + IAB Open Measurement (OM-SDK) + click-tag macro substitution + backup image fallback. Receivers unpack the zip, validate internal structure, and serve from CDN. Distinct from `image` (static, non-interactive) and `display_tag` (third-party served). The zip's entry point is typically `index.html`; click handling uses `clickTag` (or `clickTAG`) macro substitution.

allOf.title: Size-mode mutex
allOf.description: Exactly one of: (a) fixed (`width` + `height` both set), (b) multi-size (`sizes` set), (c) responsive (any of `min_width`/`max_width`/`min_height`/`max_height` set), (d) none (no size fields). Combining modes is rejected at schema layer. Omitted size fields mean no constraint only when the enclosing declaration asserts technical_requirements_complete: true; otherwise acceptance is undeclared. Semantic validators check responsive bound ordering and intersect all applicable declaration layers.

slots.description: Default slots for html5 canonical. Buyer ships a zip bundle plus optional backup image (required when `backup_image_required: true`) and clickthrough URL. The zip's entry point is typically `index.html`; click handling uses the `clickTag` (or `clickTAG`) macro substituted by the seller at serve time.

width.description: Accepted logical entry-canvas width in pixels for a fixed-size slot; height must also be set. Alternatively use `sizes[]` or responsive `min_width`/`max_width`/`min_height`/`max_height` bounds. These modes are mutually exclusive, but no size mode is also structurally valid. Omission follows the enclosing declaration's technical_requirements_complete assertion.

height.description: Accepted logical entry-canvas height in pixels for a fixed-size slot; width must also be set. See `width` for size-mode mutual exclusion and omission semantics.

sizes.description: List of accepted (width, height) pairs for a multi-size flexible slot (publisher banner that accepts 300×250 OR 728×90 OR 970×250). Mirrors OpenRTB `banner.format[]`. Mutually exclusive with `(width, height)` and with responsive ranges.

min_width.description: Inclusive minimum accepted logical width for responsive HTML5 banners. May be one-sided; when max_width is also declared, min_width MUST be <= max_width. Omitted bounds follow the enclosing declaration's technical_requirements_complete assertion. Mutually exclusive with `(width, height)` and `sizes[]`.

max_width.description: Inclusive maximum accepted logical width for responsive HTML5 banners. May be one-sided; when min_width is also declared, max_width MUST be >= min_width. Omitted bounds follow the enclosing declaration's technical_requirements_complete assertion.

min_height.description: Inclusive minimum accepted logical height for responsive HTML5 banners. May be one-sided; when max_height is also declared, min_height MUST be <= max_height. Omitted bounds follow the enclosing declaration's technical_requirements_complete assertion.

max_height.description: Inclusive maximum accepted logical height for responsive HTML5 banners. May be one-sided; when min_height is also declared, max_height MUST be >= min_height. Omitted bounds follow the enclosing declaration's technical_requirements_complete assertion.

max_initial_load_kb.description: Maximum initial-load file size (zip + above-the-fold assets) in kilobytes. IAB display standards: 200 KB for fixed sizes, 100 KB for mobile.

max_polite_load_kb.description: Maximum polite-load file size after host-initiated subload, in kilobytes. IAB display standards: 500 KB for fixed sizes.

host_initiated_subload.description: Whether the host page must initiate the polite-load phase. IAB-compliant banners require true.

max_animation_duration_ms.description: Maximum total animation duration in milliseconds. IAB standard: 30000 (30 seconds).

max_cpu_load_percent.description: Maximum CPU load percentage during render.

mraid_required.description: Whether MRAID compatibility is required (mobile in-app).

mraid_version.description: Required MRAID version when mraid_required is true.

om_sdk_required.description: Whether IAB Open Measurement SDK integration is required.

clicktag_macro.description: Name of the click-tag macro the bundle must use.

backup_image_required.description: Whether a backup image must accompany the zip for non-HTML5 environments.

backup_image_max_size_kb.description: Maximum backup image file size in kilobytes.

verifier_constraints.responsive_bound_order: When both bounds are declared, min_width MUST be <= max_width and min_height MUST be <= max_height. Reversed bounds invalidate the declaration; validators MUST NOT swap or discard endpoints. One-sided bounds and equal endpoints are valid.
verifier_constraints.effective_acceptance_intersection: Intersect the complete width/height pairs and inclusive responsive bounds of every applicable product, publisher, and placement declaration, including referenced narrowing artifacts. Each serving pair MUST satisfy every layer. An empty intersection is ineligible for that placement; neither declaration order nor a broader option overrides a narrower layer.
verifier_constraints.omitted_size_constraints: Omitted size modes or bounds mean no constraint only when the enclosing layer asserts technical_requirements_complete: true. Otherwise the acceptance envelope is undeclared; unresolved layers or artifacts MUST NOT be discarded to claim full compatibility.
